question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
WITH annual_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER) AS businessentityid,
        date_trunc('year', TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS order_year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) AS annual_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid <> ''
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS INTEGER), date_trunc('year', TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE))
),
annual_quota AS (
    SELECT 
        TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER) AS businessentityid,
        date_trunc('year', TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS quota_year,
        SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS annual_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS INTEGER), date_trunc('year', TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE))
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.businessentityid, q.businessentityid) AS businessentityid,
    COALESCE(s.order_year, q.quota_year) AS order_year,
    ROUND(s.annual_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
    ROUND(q.annual_quota, 2) AS annual_quota,
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.annual_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.annual_quota, 0), 2) AS difference
FROM annual_sales s
FULL OUTER JOIN annual_quota q
    ON s.businessentityid = q.businessentityid
    AND s.order_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY businessentityid, order_year
